text: Seeds out, skin off: what's in a hundred grams of papaya flesh?
Forty-three calories, one point seven grams of fibre, and sixty-one milligrams of vitamin C.
It's eighty-eight percent water, and water has no calories.
Fibre aids digestion, and vitamin C helps your body absorb iron.
A cup of papaya cubes is about a hundred forty-five grams, or sixty-two calories.
